name: Distribution Of Tractor Unit Under CMSGUY
briefDescription: The "Distribution of Tractor Unit" scheme is meant to revive the agricultural sector and help in doubling the farmer’s income by 2022. The government will provide one tractor along with some necessary accessories in each revenue village at subsidized rates. 10,000+ tractors will be distributed.
eligibilityMd:
1. A group of 8-10 members who are the actual adult farmers of the same village. 1. The group should have a common bank account and will apply jointly with the signatures of each member on the application form preferably along with particulars of land and crops cultivated. 1. The applicant group should not have more than one member from one family.
***NOTE: The scheme benefits cannot be availed by individuals.***
